b2-06-01.title: Communicative Challenge: What Bothers You
b2-06-01.scenario: You are Carlos. You work in an office in Budapest, and a friend asks what bothers and worries you at work.
b2-06-01.prompt: Tell your friend what bothers you and what worries you.
b2-06-01.target: Me molesta que haya tanto ruido y me preocupa no terminar el informe a tiempo.
b2-06-01.english: It bothers me that there is so much noise, and I am worried about not finishing the report on time.
b2-06-01.canDo: I can say what bothers, worries or delights me with me molesta que, me preocupa que and me encanta que.

b2-06-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Sorry and Afraid
b2-06-02.scenario: You are Meg, a student in Budapest. Carlos tells you that he has to work this weekend, and you answer with sympathy.
b2-06-02.prompt: Tell Carlos that you are sorry and say what you fear.
cues: Say you are sorry about his news
Say what you are afraid of
b2-06-02.target: Siento que tengas que trabajar este fin de semana y temo que estés muy cansado.
b2-06-02.english: I'm sorry that you have to work this weekend and I'm afraid that you will be very tired.
b2-06-02.canDo: I can say that I am sorry or afraid about what others do with siento que, lamento que and temo que.

b2-06-03.title: Communicative Challenge: What a Shame!
b2-06-03.scenario: You are Carlos. A colleague tells you that the cinema in your neighbourhood in Budapest is going to close.
b2-06-03.prompt: React to the news with exclamations.
cues: Add a short exclamation about the shame
b2-06-03.target: ¡Qué barbaridad que cierren el cine del barrio! ¡Qué pena!
b2-06-03.english: How outrageous that they are closing the neighbourhood cinema! What a shame!
b2-06-03.canDo: I can react to news with ¡Qué pena que...!, ¡Qué bien que...! and ¡Qué bueno que...!

b2-06-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Fact That
b2-06-04.scenario: You are Carlos. A friend is often late when you meet in Budapest, and you tell Meg how that affects you.
b2-06-04.prompt: Tell Meg how you feel about it, starting with the fact.
cues: Start with the fact that your friend arrives late
Say how it makes you feel
b2-06-04.target: El hecho de que mi amigo llegue tarde me molesta.
b2-06-04.english: The fact that my friend arrives late bothers me.
b2-06-04.canDo: I can start a sentence with el hecho de que + subjunctive and then comment on the fact.

b2-06-05.title: Communicative Challenge: News and Problems
b2-06-05.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks what you think about a news story on unemployment.
b2-06-05.prompt: Give the fact first and then your reaction.
cues: Say that there is a lot of unemployment
Say what worries you about it
b2-06-05.target: Hay mucho desempleo y me preocupa que no haya más ayuda para las familias.
b2-06-05.english: There is a lot of unemployment and it worries me that there is no more help for families.
b2-06-05.canDo: I can talk about news and social problems by giving the fact first and my reaction second.

b2-06-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Banned Books
b2-06-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks what you think about countries that ban books.
b2-06-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg what worries you and what you regret.
b2-06-consolidation.target: Me preocupa que prohíban libros y lamento que algunos lectores no puedan leerlos.
b2-06-consolidation.english: It worries me that they ban books and I regret that some readers cannot read them.
b2-06-consolidation.canDo: I can say what bothers or worries me, and that I am sorry or afraid, with que + subjunctive.
